stumbles.quote: names the Muninn `github` tool call to use instead
stumbles.why: Muninn and its `github` tool are never explained; a reader doesn't know what system this is or how to call it.
Doesn't say why a session gets 403 (e.g., token permissions), so the rationale is unclear, though the guard's purpose can be inferred.

point: The commit extends the guard that blocks GitHub release/tag creation from sessions so it also catches `gh api` POST calls to `/releases` and `/git/refs` paths, not just `gh release create`, and adds tests.
